value.command: Run SyncNotificationsTest on an isolated emulator with DiagnosticsTestRunner and an explicit synthetic loopback DSN; select the emulator serial for every adb command.
steps: Build app unit tests and Lisa Debug/test APKs with diagnosticDeliveryChecks=true; install only to the isolated emulator and grant POST_NOTIFICATIONS.

Run adb -s <isolated-emulator-serial> shell am instrument -w -r -e class com.nextgis.mobile.reliability.SyncNotificationsTest -e diagnosticsDsn http://synthetic@127.0.0.1:9/1 -e diagnosticsRun sync-notifications com.nextgis.mobile.debug.test/com.nextgis.mobile.util.DiagnosticsTestRunner.
value.expected: Unit API 26/36 reproduces inactive-progress repost and destroyed callbacks across the next session and preserves explicit optional messages. Native notifications show only readable errors by default, remove orphan manual/account progress without clearing errors, and disappear after bound account finish/cancel despite delayed progress. No physical phone or live NGW accounts.
